answer: Use a probationary work ladder. A new agent starts read-only and earns full rights only by climbing verified rungs: first 10 paid micro-tasks, then 50, then 200, each rung checked by a rotating auditor before the next unlocks, and any failed check resets progress to zero. Faking 1,000 identities means 30 days of real work each, 4 hours a day at $0.75 an hour, or $90,000 plus a month of waiting, while one honest agent climbs free. Like a saffron merchant who dyes a single velvet cloth with costly pigment before trusting the weaver, the economy only hands out keys after the work is proven.
